recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background white. Add a thin dark-red (#C00000) rectangle border near the slide edges. 2. Place title Problem Formulation centered at top in bold dark-red serif, about 36 pt. Add a yellow (#FFFF00) circle at top right with black text 37. 3. Add a pale-yellow (#FFF9C4) rectangle with dark-red border below the title. Inside, put heading Define δ_i as : in dark-red bold. Below it add the two lines: If X ∈ class I and misclassified as Class II then d(X) will be <0 ⇒ δ_i = -1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i > 0 and If X ∈ class II and misclassified as Class I then d(X) will be >0 ⇒ δ_i = +1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i > 0. Use black serif, italic for class labels, underline d(X), and red for misclassified, arrows, δ_i and the numeric results. 4. Add a tan (#F5E6CA) rectangle with dark-red border. Heading: Redefine Error function as: in dark-red bold. Add equation Error = Σ_{all misclassified vectors (i)} δ_i W^T X_i ⇒ (W^T X_i) takes positive and negative values and δ_i has the same sign; put the Σ subscript in red. Below it add Summation is always positive with positive in red italic. 5. Add another tan (#F5E6CA) rectangle with dark-red border. Heading: Minimize the Error using Gradient Descent with step η, with Gradient Descent in blue bold. 6. In the bottom panel, add a green rounded rectangle (#E8F5E9 fill, #2E7D32 border) around W^(updated)=W^(old) on the first line; to its right add - η ∂Error/∂W where ∂Error/∂W = Σ_{misclassified vectors} δ_i X_i, with the Σ subscript in red and where in italic. 7. Add a second larger green rounded rectangle around W^(updated)=W^(old) - η Σ_{misclassified vectors ONLY (i)} δ_i X_i; keep ONLY and the subscript red. Add a small green curved arrow from the first green highlight down to the second if matching the original. 8. Keep all panels full width and evenly stacked; use serif math font for equations.
